data.promptProse: In the quiet aisles of an expansive wooden archive, Surtr leans against a study table, turning the fragile pages of a weathered history tome with quiet focus. Golden afternoon sunbeams filter between towering bookshelves, highlighting drifting dust motes and her thoughtful expression.
